# TickerMint API examples

> Examples and agent rules for the TickerMint REST API (https://api.tickermint.cards) and MCP server (https://api.tickermint.cards/mcp): daily TCGplayer market prices since 2024-02-08 for about 130,000 Pokemon, One Piece, Lorcana, Riftbound, Gundam and Yu-Gi-Oh cards and sealed products.

Key rules: send TICKERMINT_API_KEY as the X-API-Key header (optional, keyless trial is 100 lookups a day per IP); call from server code with a User-Agent; prices are decimal strings; cache answers at least 1 hour; show a visible "Prices: TickerMint" link to tickermint_url next to prices (all plans below API Platform); commercial use needs API Pro ($49/mo) or above; never mirror the dataset.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seankarltonlee/tickermint-examples/main/README.md): plan table, quickstarts, attribution, errors, endpoints
